basic_info.description: Charming 1940s home on a prime Outer Sunset block. An ornate fireplace gives the living room a nice refined feel. The dining area is adjacent to the bright kitchen. Beautiful hardwood floors cover most of the main level, where all 3 of the spacious bedrooms are found. There is an elegant tile bathroom off the hall and another off the rear bedroom. A handy deck looks out to the deep & inviting backyard. Plenty of space for parking, storage, and expansion potential is found downstairs. If you are looking for a move-in ready home with an ideal layout in a great Sunset location, look no further than 1862 42nd Avenue. This lovely home is situated just minutes from great schools, Ocean Beach, and all the cool shops along Noriega.
